import os, sys, time, json, subprocess, pathlib, hashlib, shutil
ROOT=pathlib.Path('/tmp/slopdb-batch100-20261016')
SRC={'slopdb':pathlib.Path('/tmp/slopdb-select-bench-20261014/database-small'),'sqlite':pathlib.Path('/tmp/slopdb-select-bench-20261014/sqlite-c/bench.sqlite')}
SMOKE={'slopdb':pathlib.Path('/tmp/slopdb-select-bench-20261014/smoke-small-v4'),'sqlite':pathlib.Path('/tmp/slopdb-select-bench-20261014/sqlite-c/smoke.sqlite')}
def run(engine,workload,writers,label,seconds=30,warmup=10,samples=3,mem=64,shared=0,durable=False,checkpoint=64,smoke=False,profile=False,busy_us=1000,binary_name=None,volatile_ids=False,procs=96,group_wait_us=0,no_wal=False,hash_memtable=False):
 case=ROOT/label
 case.mkdir()
 if shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free<70*(1<<30): raise RuntimeError('Free space below 70 GiB')
 database=case/('database' if engine=='slopdb' else 'bench.sqlite')
 if workload.startswith('update'):
  source=(SMOKE if smoke else SRC)[engine]
  subprocess.run(['cp','--reflink=always','-a',str(source),str(database)],check=True)
 binary=ROOT/(binary_name or (engine+'-bench'))
 args=[str(binary),'--db',str(database),'--workload',workload,'--writers',str(writers),'--seconds',str(seconds),'--warmup',str(warmup),'--samples',str(samples),'--hot',str(10000 if smoke else 1000000)]
 if engine=='slopdb':
  args+=['--rows-per-tx','100']
  args+=['--mem-mib',str(mem),'--procs',str(procs)]
  if durable: args+=['--durable']
  if no_wal: args+=['--no-wal']
  if hash_memtable: args+=['--hash-memtable']
  if volatile_ids: args+=['--volatile-ids']
  if profile: args+=['--profile',str(case/'cpu.pprof')]
 else: args+=['--shared',str(shared),'--durable',str(int(durable)),'--checkpoint-mib',str(checkpoint),'--busy-us',str(busy_us)]
 env=os.environ.copy();env.update(GOGC='200',GOMAXPROCS=str(procs))
 (case/'command.json').write_text(json.dumps({'args':args,'GOGC':200,'GOMAXPROCS':procs,'source':str((SMOKE if smoke else SRC)[engine]) if workload.startswith('update') else None},indent=2)+'\n')
 print('START',label,flush=True)
 rss=0;vms=0;io={};threads=0;t0=time.monotonic();observed=0
 with (case/'raw.jsonl').open('w') as out,(case/'stderr.log').open('w') as err:
  p=subprocess.Popen(args,stdout=out,stderr=err,env=env,cwd='/home/dmituzas/slopdb')
  with (case/'resources.jsonl').open('w') as res:
   while p.poll() is None:
    raw=(case/'raw.jsonl').read_text()
    lines=raw.splitlines(keepends=True)
    for line in lines[observed:]:
     if not line.endswith('\n'):break
     row=json.loads(line);observed+=1
     if row.get('type')=='sample':
      print('SAMPLE',label,'phase',row['phase'],'TPS',round(row['tps']),'cores',round(row['cpu_cores'],2),'flushes',row.get('flushes','?'),'groups',row.get('write_groups','?'),flush=True)
    try:
     status={s.split(':',1)[0]:s.split(':',1)[1].strip() for s in pathlib.Path(f'/proc/{p.pid}/status').read_text().splitlines()}
     io={k:int(v) for k,v in [s.split(':',1) for s in pathlib.Path(f'/proc/{p.pid}/io').read_text().splitlines()]}
     rr=int(status.get('VmRSS','0 kB').split()[0])*1024; vv=int(status.get('VmSize','0 kB').split()[0])*1024
     rss=max(rss,rr);vms=max(vms,vv);threads=max(threads,int(status.get('Threads','0')))
     res.write(json.dumps({'seconds':time.monotonic()-t0,'rss_bytes':rr,'vms_bytes':vv,'io':io})+'\n');res.flush()
    except (FileNotFoundError,ProcessLookupError,PermissionError):pass
    time.sleep(1)
 if p.returncode:
  print((case/'raw.jsonl').read_text(),flush=True);print((case/'stderr.log').read_text(),flush=True)
  raise RuntimeError(f'{label}: exit {p.returncode}')
 records=[json.loads(s) for s in (case/'raw.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
 assert records[-1]['type']=='verify' and records[-1]['ok']
 result={'label':label,'records':records,'peak_rss_bytes':rss,'peak_vms_bytes':vms,'max_threads':threads,'last_proc_io':io,'wall_seconds':time.monotonic()-t0}
 timed=[r for r in records if r['type']=='sample' and r['phase']>=0]
 if no_wal:
  assert all(not r['wal_enabled'] and not r['wal_active'] for r in timed)
  assert not list(database.glob('WAL-*.log'))
 (case/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
 with (ROOT/'results.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(result)+'\n')
 print('DONE',label,'TPS',','.join(str(round(r['tps'])) for r in timed),'cores',','.join(str(round(r['cpu_cores'],2)) for r in timed),'verified',records[-1]['commits_including_warmup'],flush=True)
 return result
if __name__=='__main__':
 for engine in ['slopdb','sqlite']:
  for work in ['insert-random','insert-auto','update-random','update-sequential']:
   for shared in ([0,1] if engine=='sqlite' else [0]):
    run(engine,work,96,f'smoke-{engine}-{work}-shared{shared}',seconds=.5,warmup=.1,samples=1,smoke=True)
